endorsements.name: Fabian Henneke
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-1772
endorsements.description: It's possible to craft Lost Password requests with wildcards in the Token value, which allows attacker to retrieve valid Token(s), generated by users which already requested new passwords. This issue affects: ((OTRS)) Community Edition 5.0.41 and prior versions, 6.0.26 and prior versions. OTRS: 7.0.15 and prior versions.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.5)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Fabian Henneke
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-1773
endorsements.description: An attacker with the ability to generate session IDs or password reset tokens, either by being able to authenticate or by exploiting OSA-2020-09, may be able to predict other users session IDs, password reset tokens and automatically generated passwords. This issue affects ((OTRS)) Community Edition: 5.0.41 and prior versions, 6.0.26 and prior versions. OTRS; 7.0.15 and prior versions.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.3)
